name: Imperial College London

sources.label: Imperial What's On (JSON)
sources.note: Events API behind imperial.ac.uk/events-api-explorer. Array at data.events; fields title, summary, description (HTML), starts.iso8601, ends.iso8601, venue, displayAddress, categories, groups, cost, url.absolute. Paginate with start=100,200... (meta.page.total = 365 upcoming).

sources.label: Imperial What's On (RSS)
sources.note: Same feed as RSS, 30 per page; /events/feed/atom/ also works.

sources.label: IB Connect (Business School, CampusGroups)
sources.note: CampusGroups school-wide feed; RSS with structured fields at https://ibconnect.imperial.ac.uk/rss_events

notes: Imperial College Union (imperialcollegeunion.org, Next.js) exposes no feed. talks.ee.ic.ac.uk (talks.cam clone) found but no lists linked from its home page.

name: University of Oxford
notes: talks.ox.ac.uk now redirects to events.ox.ac.uk (Oxford Events, the 2026 replacement for OxTalks); both return CloudFront 403/429 to plain GETs, so its API is not usable from a server. Oxford SU (MSL) feed https://www.oxfordsu.org/ents/rss/0/subtree/ works but had 0 events. Maths Institute advertises RSS but no URL found.

name: University of Cambridge
notes: talks.cam.ac.uk: every list has /show/ics/<id>/ (trailing slash required) and /show/rss/<id>/; no JSON. Any list id works, so more departments can be added. MSL student unions share the /ents/rss/0/subtree/ pattern.

name: ETH Zurich

sources.label: ETH event calendar (PCM API)
sources.note: API behind ethz.ch/en/news-and-events/events.html. Array at entry-array; title content.title, description content.description, dates date-time-indication.date-with-times-array[].date/time-from/time-to, location location.internal (building/addition) and location.address, organizers. ~2 MB response.

notes: Events are in English (188) and German (113, plus untagged); match German food words too (Apéro, Essen, Verpflegung, Pizza, Snacks, Imbiss, kostenlos).

name: National University of Singapore

sources.label: NUSync RSS (CampusGroups)
sources.note: CampusGroups RSS with structured fields per item: group, groupType, eventDate, eventTime, title, fullDescription, location, eventLink.

notes: NUSync is CampusGroups, school code nusg: student-org events, prime free-food territory. www.nus.edu.sg/events returned a near-empty page; no university-wide feed found.

name: University College London
notes: www.ucl.ac.uk (events, /events/feed, /events/rss) is behind a Cloudflare challenge (403). Students' Union UCL (studentsunionucl.org, Drupal) exposes no feed; ucl.libcal.com not reachable. Only timetable ics found.

name: Nanyang Technological University
notes: NTU Sphere (soms.ntu.edu.sg / sphere.ntu.edu.sg) is CampusGroups. Main ntu.edu.sg events page has no feed.

name: Tsinghua University
notes: tsinghua.edu.cn runs the VSB/博达 CMS (static .htm lists, /system/resource/js/ajax.js), no RSS/ics/JSON for 讲座/学生活动 pages. Content is Chinese. No feed found.

name: Peking University
notes: pku.edu.cn/dat/campusLife.json is open JSON but holds 2 news items, not events. 学术预告 (news.pku.edu.cn/xywh/xxyg.htm) and hall.pku.edu.cn are HTML only (VSB CMS). Content is Chinese. No feed found.

name: University of Melbourne

sources.label: UniMelb Events (LiveWhale)
sources.note: Returned 1000 (likely capped); RSS at /live/rss/events. Fields include title, date_iso, location, cost, group_title, event_types, tags.

notes: www.unimelb.edu.au/events returns 403; events.unimelb.edu.au is open.

name: University of Hong Kong
notes: hku.hk/en/news-events/events is AEM with server-rendered cards, no feed (/bin/hku/api/search needs params, 400). hkuems1.hku.hk event system is an old frameset. No libcal found. Content in English and Chinese.

name: University of Toronto

sources.label: U of T Libraries tri-campus workshops (LibCal)

notes: www.utoronto.ca/events is a Drupal aggregator of department sites with no ics/rss/jsonapi. Student Life (WordPress) has no events feed; engineering WP sites deny access. No Localist or Engage found. Other LibCal calendars: cid 8501 (special events), 8054.

name: University of Sydney
notes: University What's On (whatson.sydney.edu.au) is a React app on AWS AppSync GraphQL, not a plain GET. USU = University of Sydney Union, student clubs: good for free food.

name: King's College London
notes: kcl.ac.uk/events is a Contensis React site (data in window.REDUX_DATA, no public feed). KCLSU (kclsu.org, MSL) is behind Cloudflare (403), including /ents/rss/0/subtree/. libcal.kcl.ac.uk 'Events' calendar (cid 9044) had 0 events.

name: McGill University
notes: www.mcgill.ca (channels events and its RSS) is behind an Azure WAF JS challenge (403). SSMU calendar ics (https://ssmu.ca/events/?ical=1) works but only holds 2019 events. No Engage/CampusGroups found. Events may be in French: match French food words (nourriture, repas, collation, gratuit, pizza, café).

name: EPFL

sources.label: EPFL Memento
sources.note: Paginated: count, next, results[]. Fields title, description (HTML), start_date, start_time, end_date, place_and_room, organizer, registration.en_label, keywords, lang, event_url, icalendar_url. Returns upcoming events.

notes: Events in English and French (lang field); match French food words (apéro, apéritif, repas, collation, buffet, verrée, gratuit).

name: Technical University of Munich

sources.label: TUM events
sources.note: pubDate is the event start time.

notes: English feed; the German site has the same events. Some events are German-language: match German food words (Essen, Verpflegung, Imbiss, Snacks, Brezn, Freibier, kostenlos).

name: University of Tokyo

sources.label: UTokyo events (Japanese)
sources.note: pubDate is the posting date, not the event date; title and organizing unit only, details on the linked page.

notes: Main feed is Japanese: match Japanese food words (軽食, 食事, 懇親会, ランチ, 弁当, お菓子, 無料, 茶話会).

name: Fudan University

sources.label: Fudan news: 通知公告 (announcements)
sources.note: WebPlus CMS RSS; announcements incl. events, job fairs and performances; pubDate is the posting date.

notes: Chinese only: match Chinese food words (免费, 餐, 午餐, 晚餐, 茶歇, 披萨, 零食, 食物, 自助). Any WebPlus column has RSS at /_wp3services/rssoffer?siteId=<n>&columnId=<n>; no dedicated lecture/events column found that is current.

name: UNSW Sydney
notes: www.events.unsw.edu.au (Drupal 9) has no rss/ics/jsonapi. Arc UNSW clubs use Rubric (campus.hellorubric.com), no open feed found. Only academic key-date ics on student.unsw.edu.au.
